title: Great Heat Solar Term
prompt: Describe the significance of the Great Heat solar term in ancient Chinese culture.
hint: Explain how the Great Heat solar term affects agriculture and daily life.
sample: The Great Heat solar term marks the hottest period of the year, guiding farmers on crop growth and influencing traditional customs such as eating ginger and pineapples for health and prosperity.

title: Chongqing's Geography and Climate

title: Chongqing's Spicy Cuisine
prompt: Discuss why spicy food, especially hot pots with chilies, is popular in Chongqing during the Great Heat solar term.

sample: Chongqing people love spicy hot pots during the Great Heat because the heat and chilies help them cope with the intense summer temperatures and maintain their cultural identity.
